home.problem.intro.defaultMessage: Indian neighbourhood shops already stock what people need. But running the counter, the stock and the customers by hand leaves money on the shelf.

home.problem.1.title.defaultMessage: Stock is hard to keep track of

home.problem.1.body.defaultMessage: Items get missed and counts drift, so it is hard to know what is selling.

home.problem.2.title.defaultMessage: People nearby do not know you have it

home.problem.2.body.defaultMessage: Someone may need an item that is on your shelf, a few minutes away, and never find out.

home.problem.3.body.defaultMessage: Without a view of demand it is easy to overstock the wrong things.

home.problem.4.title.defaultMessage: You cannot see what people want

home.problem.4.body.defaultMessage: Shops rarely know what people around them are searching for.

home.features.title.defaultMessage: A simple way to grow your shop

home.features.intro.defaultMessage: One app for the counter, the stock and the customers. Built for everyday shop work, in your language.

home.features.1.body.defaultMessage: Bill at the counter, keep stock up to date and see your customers in one app. It keeps working when the internet drops.

home.features.2.body.defaultMessage: Shoppers find your stock, book it, and pick it up or ask for delivery.

home.features.3.body.defaultMessage: Every sale updates your stock, and shoppers see how fresh it is before they come.

home.features.4.body.defaultMessage: Offers and credits give people a reason to come to your shop again.

home.types.intro.defaultMessage: If you sell physical goods from a shop near people's homes, TodayZ is built for you.

home.types.strip.defaultMessage: Made for every kind of shop
home.types.strip.description: Accessible name of the scrolling strip of shop types.

home.types.desc.1.defaultMessage: Daily needs, staples and packaged food.

home.types.desc.3.defaultMessage: Beauty, skin care and personal care.

home.types.desc.5.defaultMessage: Chargers, bulbs, cables and small appliances.

home.testimonials.title.description: Shown only once real, approved quotes exist.

home.faq.intro.defaultMessage: Something else on your mind? Leave your details below and the TodayZ team will get in touch.

home.faq.1.a.defaultMessage: TodayZ is free for shops for now. See the pricing page for the latest.

home.faq.2.q.defaultMessage: Do I need to be good with phones?

home.faq.2.a.defaultMessage: No. The business app is built for everyday shop work, and you can start with a few items.

home.faq.3.q.defaultMessage: How do shoppers get their items?

home.faq.3.a.defaultMessage: They book the item on TodayZ, then pick it up from your shop or ask for delivery.

home.faq.4.a.defaultMessage: Any neighbourhood shop that sells physical goods, from grocery to hardware.

home.types.pause.description: Label of the checkbox that pauses the scrolling strip of shop types (WCAG 2.2.2).

home.lede.body.defaultMessage: Find it in a shop nearby, book it in the app, and walk over to collect it. No fee for pickup and no days of waiting, just a short walk.

home.lede.search_placeholder.defaultMessage: Search milk, a phone charger, paracetamol…

home.lede.stat.3.label.defaultMessage: Search radius to start, up to 20 km

home.cost.sub.defaultMessage: Time, patience or money. Today you pay at least one of the three, and often all of them.

home.cost.1.body.defaultMessage: You walk from shop to shop, asking and waiting, and still head home empty-handed.

home.cost.2.body.defaultMessage: It is on a screen in seconds and at your door in days, for something a shop down the road already had.

home.cost.3.body.defaultMessage: Fast, but delivery, handling and small-basket charges quietly add up on every order.

home.cost.way.title.defaultMessage: Search once. Book. Walk over. Pay the shop.

home.walk.sub.defaultMessage: Find it, book it, and collect it from a shop down the road. Watch one short walk play out.

home.walk.map.defaultMessage: A walking route from you to Sharma General Store, 600 m away.

home.walk.scroll.defaultMessage: Walking route map, scrolls sideways on small screens

home.walk.step.1.body.defaultMessage: Type what you need. See the shops nearby that have it in stock.

home.walk.step.2.body.defaultMessage: Book it at the shop's price, and the shop gets it ready.

home.walk.step.3.body.defaultMessage: The app shows how far the shop is. Walk over when it suits you.

home.walk.step.4.body.defaultMessage: Show your pickup code, pay the shop, and earn its cashback if it gives one.

home.walk.note.defaultMessage: Example. Walking time assumes about 5 km an hour.

home.week.title.defaultMessage: The best shop is the one {em}

home.week.sub.defaultMessage: Every pickup turns an errand into a short walk. No delivery charge, no rider on the road for one packet of biscuits, and you see more of the neighbourhood you live in.

home.week.perk.1.body.defaultMessage: Search shows how far each shop is, so you can pick the short walk.

home.week.perk.2.title.defaultMessage: Cashback where the shop gives it

home.week.perk.2.body.defaultMessage: Each shop sets its own cashback, from 0 to 20%, paid to you in credits.

home.week.perk.3.body.defaultMessage: Nothing extra to pay for pickup, and no delivery bag for a single item.

home.week.rings.defaultMessage: Example week: 4.9 km walked, 58 minutes on foot, 6 pickups.

home.week.bars.defaultMessage: Distance walked each day of an example week, highest on Saturday.

home.week.days.defaultMessage: M T W T F S S

home.orbit.sub.defaultMessage: Search starts with the shops within 2 km, and you can widen it to 20 km. Tap a shop to see what it holds and how far the walk is.

home.save.sub.defaultMessage: Move a few of your monthly orders from delivery to the shop down the road.

home.save.fee.defaultMessage: Fees you pay per delivered order

home.save.note.defaultMessage: Illustrative. Each shop sets its own cashback, from 0 to 20%, and many give none. Walking time assumes about 5 km an hour.

home.owners.body.defaultMessage: Be found by shoppers nearby, earn 30 credits for every customer you bring onto TodayZ, and know what to restock before you run out.

home.owners.1.body.defaultMessage: Shoppers within their search radius see your stock when they search.

home.owners.2.body.defaultMessage: When someone you refer completes a first order of ₹100 or more. 1 credit = ₹1, paid out monthly.

home.owners.3.body.defaultMessage: Daily tips on what to restock and what to put on offer.
